newsitem.title: USA: Action sets acquisition, licensing deal.
newsitem.headline: Action sets acquisition, licensing deal.

text.p: Action Performance Cos Inc said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Robert Yates Promotions Inc for undisclosed terms.
The company said the deal should be accretive to earnings but declined to provide further details. Industry sources estimated Robert Yates Promotions Inc had annual revenues of about $10 million.
The acquisition, subject to due diligence and other conditions, is expected to be closed in two to three weeks.
Action also entered a 15-year licensing agreement with Robert Yates Racing Inc for the exclusive merchandising rights for two NASCAR Winston Cup race cars.
